name: Taran
details: You're the best!! Thank you so much for the excellent dental care you've given me. My wisdom tooth extraction was painless. Your professional expertise, integrity and compassionate concern for the person on the other end of the drill are most appreciated. I also thank you for the scaling you did — it certainly has made my teeth look whiter, brighter and shinier. Much appreciated. Thanks a lot!

name: anshu pal
details: Dr. Shruti ma'am is definitely an exceptional dentist. She first understands the root cause of the problem and then suggests the required treatment. Thank you so much for giving the appropriate treatment for my teeth.

name: Sakshi Khevi
details: Dr. Shruti Malik is one of the best dentists I have ever gone to. She is an excellent listener and gives the best possible advice to her patients. The consultation charges and the treatment fees are very reasonable. She makes extra efforts to make her patients understand the problem and the course of treatment.

name: Priya Sharma
details: Had my root canal done by Dr. Malik and honestly, I was dreading it for weeks. The whole procedure was so smooth I almost dozed off. Two days later I was eating normally with zero pain. She explained every step before doing it, which really put me at ease. Highly recommend!

name: Rohit Verma
details: I got a dental implant after losing a molar in an accident. Dr. Shruti walked me through every option, the cost, and the recovery — no upselling, just honest advice. The implant feels exactly like a real tooth now. The clinic is spotless and the staff is genuinely warm.

name: Neha Gupta
details: Started my aligner treatment six months ago and the progress is already visible. Dr. Malik is patient with every question and the monthly check-ups are quick and easy. I love that she shares before/after photos so I can actually see the improvement. Best decision I made for myself this year.

name: Aman Singh
details: Got my scaling, polishing and whitening done together. The difference in my smile is night and day — friends keep asking what changed. Pricing was very transparent, no hidden fees. Will be coming back for regular check-ups from now on.

name: Megha Khanna
details: Brought my 6-year-old here for her first dental visit and she actually enjoyed it. Dr. Shruti is so gentle and patient with kids — she explained the cleaning like it was a fun game. My daughter now reminds me about her next appointment! Truly the most patient-friendly clinic in East Delhi.

name: Rahul Mehta
details: Came in with severe tooth sensitivity that two other dentists couldn't fix. Dr. Malik diagnosed it correctly on the first visit and the treatment plan was spot on. Within a week the sensitivity was completely gone. Her expertise as an Endodontist genuinely shows.
